nodes.title: Gear basics
nodes.description: Shoes, chalk and what to rent on your first day.
quests: Try on 2 pairs of rental shoes and pick the snug one
Chalk up before every climb in one session
Watch the beginner gear guide

nodes.title: Reading grades
nodes.description: How V-grades and gym color circuits work.
quests: Find the grade chart at your gym
Climb 3 routes from the easiest circuit
Try one route a grade harder

nodes.title: Falling safely
nodes.description: Land, roll and down-climb without getting hurt.
quests: Practice 5 controlled falls from low height
Down-climb 3 routes instead of jumping
Learn the landing roll

nodes.title: Warm-up routine
nodes.description: A 10-minute routine to start every session.
quests: Do 5 minutes of shoulder and wrist mobility
Climb 3 routes well below your grade
Warm up the same way for 2 sessions

nodes.title: Footwork basics
nodes.description: Quiet, precise feet are the fastest way to climb harder.
quests: Climb 3 easy routes with silent feet
Place every foot on the tip of your shoe
Watch the silent feet drill

nodes.title: Body positioning
nodes.description: Hips close to the wall, straight arms, push with your legs.
quests: Climb 2 routes keeping your arms straight
Turn one hip into the wall on a traverse
Film one climb and check your hips

nodes.title: Resting on the wall
nodes.description: Shake out, breathe and plan your next moves.
quests: Shake out each arm once mid-route
Hang on a big hold for 3 slow breaths
Find the rest spot on 2 routes before climbing

nodes.title: First V2
nodes.description: Send your first V2 route from start to top.
quests: Pick a V2 and try it 3 times
Work out the hardest move on its own
Send the route from start to top

nodes.title: Flagging
nodes.description: Use a free leg to stay balanced instead of swinging off.
quests: Flag your leg on 3 sideways reaches
Try an inside and an outside flag
Watch the flagging drill

nodes.title: Heel hooks
nodes.description: Pull with your heel to take weight off your arms.
quests: Place 5 heel hooks on a big hold
Pull your hips up using only the heel
Use a heel hook on one route

nodes.title: Toe hooks
nodes.description: Hook with your toes to stay on steep walls.
quests: Hold a toe hook for 5 seconds on an overhang
Stop a swing with a toe hook 3 times
Use a toe hook on one route

nodes.title: Reading a route
nodes.description: Plan the moves from the ground before you start.
quests: Plan every hand move of a route from the ground
Mime the moves before you climb
Compare your plan with how you climbed it

nodes.title: First V4
quests: Pick a V4 and read it from the ground
Link the moves in 2 sections
Send the route from start to top
